def make_key(text, profile, criteria):
    return (text, profile, criteria)

import copy
from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_all_inputs_affect_caching():
    for i, (t, p, c) in enumerate([("a", 1, 1), ("b", 1, 1), ("a", 2, 1), ("a", 1, 2)]):
        s = {}
        r1 = score(s, t, p, c, lambda: 100 + i)
        r2 = score(s, t, p, c, lambda: 100 + i)
        assert r1 == r2 == 100 + i
        assert len(s) == 1
        for t2, p2, c2 in [(t, p, c), (t, p, c + 1), (t, p + 1, c), (t, p, c), ("x", p, c), (t, p, 1)]:
            if t2 == t and p2 == p and c2 == c:
                continue
            assert (t2, p2, c2) != (t, p, c)
    s = {}
    r = score(s, "job", 2, 3, lambda: 1)
    assert s["job"] != None
    assert len(s) == 1

def test_unchanged_reuses_even_when_previous_none():
    s = {}
    def compute():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    n = 0
    r1 = score(s, "same", 1, 1, compute)
    r2 = score(s, "same", 1, 1, compute)
    assert r1 == r2 == 1
    assert len(s) == 1
    s2 = {}
    r3 = score(s2, None, None, None, compute)
    assert r3 == 1
    r4 = score(s2, None, None, None, compute)
    assert r4 == 1
    assert len(s2) == 1

def test_distinct_keys_not_ambiguous():
    assert make_key("a", None, "b") != make_key("a b", None, "b")
    assert make_key("a", 1, "c") != make_key("a", "1c", None)
    assert make_key(None, 1, None) != make_key("None", 1, None)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_all_inputs_affect_caching()
    test_unchanged_reuses_even_when_previous_none()
    test_distinct_keys_not_ambiguous()
    print("all tests passed")
